title: Fix FIPS 140 checksum validation failure
description:
[SRU] Backport FIPS 140 checksum fix to Resolute

This fix excludes the bundled FIPS 140 snapshot ZIPs from dh_strip_nondeterminism to preserve the certified upstream checksums. This aligns the golang-1.24 package in Resolute with the fix already merged for golang-1.27.

Original approved MP for sponsor context: https://code.launchpad.net/~sumit-tiwari/ubuntu/+source/golang-1.27/+git/golang-1.27/+merge/514448

PPA Build: https://launchpad.net/~sumit-tiwari/+archive/ubuntu/fix-go-native-fips/+packages?field.name_filter=golang-1.24&field.status_filter=published&field.series_filter=resolute
commit_message:
Fix FIPS 140 checksum validation failure

LP: #2174698
